review.tagline: Python framework for RAG and agent apps over your own data
review.summary: LlamaIndex is a Python toolkit that loads data from files, APIs and SQL, builds indices such as a vector store index, and exposes query engines and retrievers for LLM apps. The llama-index-core package is extended by over 300 integration packages for LLMs, embeddings and vector stores. The maintainers say their main focus has moved to the commercial LlamaParse platform, while the framework stays available as open source.
review.audience: Python developers building RAG or agent apps over private documents
strengths: Over 300 integration packages for LLM, embedding and vector store providers
Small core package plus a starter bundle; install only the integrations needed
High-level API indexes and queries a directory in a few lines
Works with local models, e.g. Ollama LLMs and Hugging Face embeddings
weaknesses: README says company focus has shifted to the paid LlamaParse platform
README is noted as less up to date than the documentation
Index storage is in-memory by default; persistence to ./storage is manual
Library only: no UI, server or Docker setup included
needs: Needs Python, LLM provider API key or local Ollama, LlamaParse account (optional)
Models: OpenAI, Ollama, Hugging Face embeddings
